$comment: Deviation d13: associate's harness-wide bound, shared by every registry model. It is no longer a copy of the retired lobes 'associate' role (worker MINUS repo_action). What each model may change is owned by models.json (may_mutate, tools, may_spawn) and enforced by lib/guard.ts and the CLEF gate; this file lists only what no model may ever do.
source: associate deviation d13 (docs/specs/2026-10-27-associate-multi-model-on-pi-1-1-0.md); per-model rights in models.json
summary: a harness that runs one registry model on a task: every model reads, finds and summarizes; models with may_mutate change the checkout behind the CLEF gate; none makes a final or security decision.

notes.addressing: Models are addressed by lobes role name through the gateway. No checkpoint id belongs in this file.
notes.enforcement: These tokens are a division-of-labour contract. They are made true by the tool surface, policy.json, models.json and the gate, not by prompt instruction.
notes.per_model: repo_action and code_authoring are granted per model by models.json may_mutate (worker, cortex) and withheld from the rest (senses).
